decisions.reason: The source specifies a one-attempt restyle and frame-recreation task but does not change the established character-detail targets or reference strategy.
The source changes the execution bounds of the restyle pass, not the already established raw-graffiti aesthetic or its style traits.
Recreating the existing frames does not explicitly alter the requirement to restore character shadows or preserve the surrounding composition.
The request to recreate frames as currently configured does not change the existing pair counts, character pairing, or framing progression.
The character-restyle task does not change SQ11 shot angles, frame selection, frame count, or specification method.
The source concerns character restyling and frame recreation, not the acceptance condition for animation quality.
The source does not change animation as the primary presentation medium or the priority to attempt animation first.
Recreating existing frames after a restyle does not activate or modify the digital-comic fallback or its activation conditions.
The source does not change SQ4 shot angles, frame counts, clarification rules, or storyboard-mismatch specification methods.
The restyle and frame-recreation request does not change the revised script's authority or the process for specifying storyboard mismatches.
The source addresses character styling rather than set-image resolution, shot-angle adjustments for set quality, or generation of new set images.
The character-restyle request does not alter the requirement that newly generated sets remain stylistically consistent across shots.
